newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Valencia sells five, 10-year bonds.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Valencia sells five, 10-year bonds.

text.p: Spain's regional government of Valencia (Generalitat de Valencia) allotted a total of 4.9 billion pesetas of five-, and 10-year bonds at a public auction on Tuesday, the regional government said.
For the first time ever the regional government allotted its
bond with a spread margin versus Spanish Treasury bonds.
Dec 2002 0.15 over Treasuries, 1.4 bln pta allotted
Dec 2007 0.14 over Treasuries, 3.5 bln pta allotted
NOTE - Previous auction was held on March 11.
